latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the self-improvement skill for OpenClaw and other coding agents:

- Enables structured logging of learnings, errors, and feature requests for continuous improvement.
- Provides detailed formats for learning, error, and feature request entries in markdown files.
- Supports both OpenClaw integration (with workspace guide and hooks) and generic agent setup.
- Guides on when and how to promote lessons and best practices to project-wide memory files.
- Includes workflows for collaboration, inter-session communication, and promotion of high-value learnings.
